senses.gloss: = preced., wild irregular growth, esp. the case of protruding boughs on one of which is an uncleanness, v. סְכָכָה. Ohol. VIII, 2 והפ׳, expl. היוצאות מן הגדר which protrude from the hedge; Tosef. ib. IX, 3 פֶּרַע היוצא מן וכ׳; Naz. VII, 3; 54ᵇ. Y. ib. VII, 56ᶜ

units: <cite ref="Shabbat 119b:5">Sabb. 119ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Judges 5:2">Jud. V, 2</cite>) <he>מ״ט בפרוע פרעות משום דברכו ה׳</he> why are decreed punishments disarranged (reversed)? Because of ‘praise the Lord’; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 46:2">Yalk. Jud. 46</cite>.
